title: Things Around Us
text:
Many things in our home are made of different materials. A table is often made of wood, and it feels hard and smooth. A blanket is made of soft wool, so it feels warm.

Some materials are cold to touch. Glass is smooth and hard, and metal is cold and shiny. We can see these materials in kitchens and in cars.

questions.text: What is a table often made of?
Why is a blanket probably good for a cold night?
options: It is made of soft wool that feels warm

questions.text: Where can we probably find glass and metal in a home?

soft hair from sheep, used to make clothes

paragraph_translations: Muitas coisas da nossa casa são feitas de materiais diferentes. Uma mesa geralmente é feita de madeira, e ela parece dura e lisa. Um cobertor é feito de lã macia, por isso parece quente.
Alguns materiais são frios ao toque. O vidro é liso e duro, e o metal é frio e brilhante. Podemos ver esses materiais em cozinhas e em carros.
